parameters.jsCode: const upper=new Date(); const saved=$json.ingest_state?.cursor; const cursor=saved?new Date(saved):new Date(upper.getTime()-26*3600000); if(cursor>upper) throw new Error('Durable cursor is after run upper bound'); const start=new Date(cursor.getTime()-2*3600000); const run_upper_bound=upper.toISOString(); return [{json:{run_id:`RAKBANK_CARD_TRANSACTION:${run_upper_bound}`,source_code:'RAKBANK_CARD_TRANSACTION',cursor_key:'outlook:rakbank',window_start:start.toISOString(),run_upper_bound}}];
const w=$('Freeze Cursor Minus Overlap Window').first().json,c=$json; return [{json:{...w,folder_id:c.folder_id,senders:JSON.parse(c.senders_json),subjects:JSON.parse(c.subjects_json)}}];

const p=$('Freeze Cursor Minus Overlap Window').first().json,sweep=$input.first().json; if(sweep.pagination_exhausted!==true||sweep.run_upper_bound!==p.run_upper_bound) throw new Error('Sweep did not exhaust the frozen window'); const messages=Array.isArray(sweep.messages)?sweep.messages:[]; const ids=new Set(messages.map(m=>String(m.id||''))); if(ids.has('')||ids.size!==messages.length) throw new Error('Every swept message needs a unique exact id'); return [{json:{schema_version:1,run_id:p.run_id,source:p.cursor_key,source_code:p.source_code,window_start:p.window_start,completed_at:p.run_upper_bound,cursor:p.run_upper_bound,scanned_count:sweep.scanned_count,matched_count:sweep.matched_count,heartbeat:messages.length===0,messages}}];

const e=$('Build Frozen Mailbox Envelope').first().json; const r=$json; if(r.cursor_committed!==false) throw new Error('Companion must not commit the mailbox cursor'); if(String(r.cursor_candidate||'')!==e.cursor) throw new Error('Cursor candidate differs from frozen upper bound'); const scanned=Number(r.parse?.scanned_count); const accepted=Number(r.parse?.accepted_count); if(scanned!==e.messages.length || !Number.isInteger(accepted) || accepted<0 || accepted>scanned) throw new Error('Companion parse counts do not reconcile'); return [{json:{source:e.source,completed_at:e.completed_at,scanned_count:scanned,accepted_count:accepted,cursor:e.cursor}}];

const expected=$('Verify Service Receipt Before Cursor').first().json; const observed=String($json.ingest_state?.cursor||''); if(observed!==expected.cursor) throw new Error('Durable cursor readback mismatch'); return [{json:{status:'SUCCESS_VERIFIED',cursor:observed,scanned_count:expected.scanned_count,accepted_count:expected.accepted_count}}];
